comparison_method: full recursive JSON diff of every top-level arm file (baseline_metrics, cell_summary, matrix_summary, preflight, publish_record, gate_record where present), every matrix cell results/artifact.json and shards/<cell>/shard.json, plus ordered ledger row comparison; volatile metadata excluded per the excluded_volatile list; absolute-path string values normalized to <ABS_PATH> before comparison

excluded_volatile.at_utc: wall-clock timestamp recorded at write time
excluded_volatile.ledger_path: absolute path string of the per-family ledger
excluded_volatile.ledger_sha256_after: ledger bytes include timestamps, so the digest is volatile
excluded_volatile.ledger_sha256_before: same class as ledger_sha256_after: digest over ledger bytes that contain published_utc timestamps
excluded_volatile.pin_seconds: wall-clock duration of the runner-compatibility pin probe (preflight timing metadata)
excluded_volatile.loader_seconds: wall-clock duration of staged-data load (preflight timing metadata)
excluded_volatile.<absolute_path_values>: any string value that is an absolute filesystem path (normalized to <ABS_PATH> before comparison)
